function.name: get_token_info
function.description: Look up a Solana token by symbol. Returns its mint address and decimals.

function.name: list_dexes
function.description: List the DEX names that get_quote accepts in its `dex` parameter.

function.name: get_quote
function.description: Get a swap quote from the Jupiter aggregator. `amount` is in the input token's smallest unit (raw integer, apply decimals). Returns outAmount in the output token's smallest unit, price impact and the route.

dex.description: Optional. Restrict routing to one DEX from list_dexes. Omit for the full aggregator.

function.name: submit_answer
function.description: Submit your final answer. Call exactly once, at the end.

amount.description: Quoted output amount in whole output-token units (not raw units), before any slippage tolerance.
